text:
Sanjay Patel: quick sync — aiming to land the kernel prefetch + continuous-batching changes this sprint. I want to confirm ownership and canary run plan.

Maria Gomez: I can take the kv heuristic PR reviews (PR #412). CI is flaky though, failing on new torch 2.2 wheel.

Ashley Chen: I can own the infra side — will look into the wheel and the macaron docker caches. ETA EOD for a rollback if needed.

Liam O'Neill: I can run the canary env tests (staging-inference-3). propose a stepped canary: 1% (30m) -> 5% (1h) -> 20% (2h). Watch p99 latency, error-rate, and token throughput. rollback if p99 +20% or error-rate >0.5%.

Maria Gomez: pushed branch: https://git.company/ri/runtime/compare/feature/kv-heuristic-412 -> fix/ci
```
# failing test excerpt
E   AssertionError: expected latency < 60ms
.../tests/perf/test_latency.py:23
```

Sanjay Patel: thx. @Maria can you post the PR link in the devex channel too? @Ashley if you need a quick rollback script I can upload one.

Ashley Chen: drop the script here pls. I'll also add a transient KMS key for canary logs. :thumbsup:

Liam O'Neill: copy of canary config I'm planning:
```yaml
canary:
  name: kernel-prefetch-240
  steps:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 5
      duration: 1h
    - pct: 20
      duration: 2h
  metrics:
    - name: latency_p99_ms
      threshold: 1.2  # 20% increase
    - name: error_rate
      threshold: 0.005  # 0.5%
  rollback: true
  monitor: prometheus:infra/llm-serving
```

Maria Gomez: added review comments to PR. two small nits, one potential perf regression in kv prefetch cold path.

Sanjay Patel: OK — owners: kernel code = Sanjay, kv heuristics = Maria, infra/canary = Liam + Ashley. timeline: aim to start canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. if CI not fixed by EOD, we swap to rollback of wheel and run canary with previous image.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: kernel-prefetch-240 at 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z -> starting when infra approval is given.

Ashley Chen: I'll give approval once the rollback script is in and KMS is set.

Maria Gomez: PR is green on a re-run with pinned torch 2.1.5. pushing the final commit now.

Liam O'Neill: I'll set up dashboards (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/s) and a slack alert channel #canaries-runtime.

Sanjay Patel: perfect. small ask — @everyone pls ping reviewers for any last-minute CRs before 09:00 PT tomorrow. we want a clean window.

Ashley Chen: ack. :white_check_mark:
